paragraphs.text: The Hour may come unexpectedly, though signs have already appeared. When it comes, remembrance will not benefit those who waited. The Messenger is told to know that there is no deity except Allah and to ask forgiveness for himself and for believing men and women. Allah knows where people move and rest. Some believers ask why a surah has not been sent down, but when a precise surah mentions fighting, hypocrites look as though death has overcome them. Obedience and good words would be better, and truthfulness before Allah would benefit them when a matter is decided. The passage warns against turning away, causing corruption, and severing family ties. Allah curses such people and blinds and deafens them. They are asked to reflect on the Qur'an rather than lock their hearts. Satan entices those who return to disbelief after guidance has become clear. They conceal what they intend, but Allah knows it. The passage also says those who turn away may sever their family relationships. Such people lose hearing and sight, and the question about locks upon hearts calls for reflection. Satan makes a return to disbelief seem appealing and lengthens hope. Some people agree secretly with those who dislike what Allah sent down, while Allah knows what they hide.

Angels take some people in death, striking their faces and backs. Their deeds become worthless because they pursued what angered Allah and disliked what earns His pleasure. Allah can expose hatred through speech and knows people's actions. Believers will be tested so that those who strive and those who are patient become evident. Those who oppose the Messenger and turn people from Allah's path cannot harm Allah; their deeds will be rendered worthless. Believers are commanded to obey Allah and the Messenger and not invalidate their own deeds. Those who die as disbelievers after turning others away from Allah's path will not receive forgiveness. Allah's test will make clear who strives for His cause and who remains patient. Their own deeds are lost. The believers are directly told to obey both Allah and the Messenger.
